executive_summary: Comprehensive overview of Introduction to Aksha
key_value_propositions: Aksha is an intelligent surveillance system designed for automated monitoring with minimal human intervention.
Utilizes advanced technologies such as Computer Vision, Artificial Intelligence, and Generative AI to enhance monitoring capabilities.
Key functionalities include object detection, anomaly detection, and real-time analysis of unusual situations.
strategic_insights: Offers multiple architectural configurations: On-Premise, Edge, and Cloud solutions.
Supports seamless integration with existing CCTV infrastructure using standard RTSP links.
Decoupled architecture enhances fault tolerance and allows independent service development.
actionable_recommendations: Live recording and processing of video data for immediate insights.
Advanced object detection capabilities, identifying various entities like vehicles, personnel, and anomalies.
Customizable alerts enable users to receive notifications tailored to specific scenarios.
